summary.text: Mike Karickhoff is a Republican who has served in the Indiana House of Representatives since 2010 and represents House District 30, which covers portions of Grant and Howard counties.
His caucus biography lists him on the Natural Resources, Government and Regulatory Reform, and Rules and Legislative Procedures committees, among others.

paragraphs.text: Karickhoff holds a B.S. in recreation and park administration from the University of Missouri.
He was superintendent of parks for the City of Kokomo from 1985 to 2002 and executive director of facilities for Ivy Tech's Kokomo, Logansport, Peru and Rochester sites from 2002 to 2019.
He served on the Kokomo Common Council from 2004 to 2010, including as president and finance chair.
In the 2022 session he authored a bill to help Indiana communities rejoin a multi-state lawsuit against pharmaceutical companies over the opioid crisis.
He and his wife, Kelly, have four daughters and 11 grandchildren.
